caption: This drawing consists of six rectangular arrangements of horizontal and vertical lines, presented on a light beige background. At the top center, there is a single square made up of fine, intersecting black lines that form a grid. Below this, there are two rectangles side by side, each composed of a denser pattern of similar horizontal and vertical black lines. At the bottom, there are three rectangles in a row; these contain both the dense grid lines and additional filled-in dark blue shapes. The dark blue areas form a repeated pattern reminiscent of vertical bars or slats, with some horizontal components and irregular filled areas, appearing as overlays on top of the black line grids. In the lower right corner of the bottom right rectangle is a handwritten signature in black ink. The lines and shapes are precise and geometric, with the color palette limited to shades of black, dark blue, and the beige tone of the paper.
title: Chart of Coverlet Thread Construction
